heroSubtitle: Improve soil function and biology on pasture and cultivated land. Terra Revive rebuilds soil structure, activates nutrient cycling, and supports healthier, more resilient agricultural systems.

problemSection.title: Why agricultural soils lose function
paragraphs: Intensive cultivation, heavy equipment traffic, and reduced organic matter inputs gradually degrade soil biology and structure. Compaction limits root growth, water infiltration declines, and biological activity slows.

Conventional approaches focus on synthetic inputs, but these do not rebuild soil structure or restore biological function. Without active soil biology, nutrient cycling weakens and long-term productivity suffers.

solutionSection.title: How Terra Revive restores agricultural soil function
solutionSection.subtitle: Terra Revive delivers concentrated organic matter, minerals, and microbial food sources that rebuild soil biology and structure. Applied at recommended rates, the pellets integrate into the soil profile and support long-term land resilience.

benefits.title: Rebuild soil biology
benefits.description: Organic matter feeds beneficial microbes that cycle nutrients and build soil structure.

benefits.title: Improve soil structure
benefits.description: Microbial activity creates aggregates that improve water infiltration and root penetration.

benefits.title: Activate nutrient cycling
benefits.description: Biological processes release and retain nutrients, reducing reliance on synthetic inputs.

benefits.title: Support long-term productivity
benefits.description: Functional soil supports healthier crops, better pasture, and more resilient agricultural systems.

methods.title: Broadcast
methods.description: Apply with standard broadcast equipment. Light incorporation recommended if equipment is available.
methods.bestFor: Best for pasture, hay fields, and areas where equipment can maneuver.

methods.title: Drill incorporation
methods.description: Apply with seed drills during seeding operations. Pellets are placed with the seed and covered.
methods.bestFor: Ideal for cultivated fields and when seed and amendment can be applied in one pass.
